title: String pattern guard
responsibility: Checks a string against a regular expression without retaining its match position.

inputs.name: matchesPattern.value
inputs.description: Unknown candidate value; non-strings return false.

inputs.name: matchesPattern.pattern
inputs.description: Regular expression to test. For string inputs, lastIndex is reset to zero before and after the test.

outputs.name: matchesPattern
outputs.description: Whether the string matches, with a string type guard on success.
